# execute, in order. Values known only at runtime appear as <placeholders>.

# snapshot container logs into <state-root>/logs/<timestamp>/ before removal

# remove staged config copies: <config-stages>
# require free ports: 7474 7687 6333 5432 4222 8080 4000 24100 24101 24102 24103 24104 24105 4318 24110 16686 14318 9090
# write <config-stage>/gateway.json (the gateway's configuration document: GatewayConfig, resolved)
# write <config-stage>/dispatcher.json (the dispatcher's configuration document: DispatcherConfig, resolved)
# stage per-service config copies under <config-stage>: archivist.toml librarian.toml worker.toml smelter.toml weaver.toml
# write into each copy the addresses this start places, as literals, in the sections that service reads (launcher-staged topology):
#   [graph] uri = bolt://<host-addr>:7687
#   [vectors] host = <host-addr>
#   [database] host = <host-addr>
#   [jobs] servers = <host-addr>:4222
#   [identity] issuer = http://<host-addr>:8080/realms/semiont
#   [embedding] baseURL = http://<host-addr>:11434
#   [inference.ollama] baseURL = http://<host-addr>:11434
# write <config-stage>/collector.yaml (launcher-owned; traces exporter iff observing)
# write <config-stage>/prometheus.yml (launcher-owned; scrapes the collector readout)
# add [environments.local.archivist] host/port (launcher-staged topology) to librarian.toml
# add [environments.local.archivist] host/port (launcher-staged topology) to worker.toml
# add [environments.local.archivist] host/port (launcher-staged topology) to smelter.toml
# resolve persistent-store stamps before any container runs: a database mismatch refuses; a projection mismatch clears the store's contents (the dir itself is kept, so attached shares survive)
# SEMIONT_VERSION=local — using locally-built :local images (no pull)
container run -d --name semiont-jaeger --memory 1G -p 16686:16686 -p 14318:4318 jaegertracing/all-in-one:1.76.0
# wait: http://localhost:16686 (30s)
container run -d --name semiont-prometheus --memory 1G -p 9090:9090 --volume <config-stage>/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro prom/prometheus:v3.9.1
# wait: http://localhost:9090/-/healthy (30s)
container run -d --name semiont-otel-collector --memory 1G -p 4318:4318 -p 24110:24110 --volume <config-stage>/collector.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml:ro otel/opentelemetry-collector:0.137.0
# wait: http://localhost:24110/metrics (30s)
# database state: <data-home>/roots/example.github.io-test-kb/postgres (created if absent; reused across restarts)
container run -d --name semiont-postgres --memory 1G -p 5432:5432 -v <data-home>/roots/example.github.io-test-kb/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data -e PGDATA=/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata -e POSTGRES_DB=semiont -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD postgres:15.18-alpine
# wait: tcp localhost:5432 (20s)
# probe: container run --rm busybox:1.38.0 nc -z -w 2 <host-addr> 5432
# wait: container exec semiont-postgres pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 (30s) — the REAL server; initdb's temporary one answers the socket only
# messaging state: <data-home>/roots/example.github.io-test-kb/nats (created if absent; reused across restarts)
# stage the broker's authorization block (no credential in it — the daemon interpolates $NATS_USER/$NATS_PASSWORD from its own environment)
container run -d --name semiont-nats --memory 512M -p 4222:4222 -v <data-home>/roots/example.github.io-test-kb/nats:/data -v <stage>/nats-semiont.conf:/etc/nats/semiont.conf:ro -e NATS_USER -e NATS_PASSWORD nats:2.14.0-alpine -js -sd /data -c /etc/nats/semiont.conf
# wait: tcp localhost:4222 (15s)
# probe: container run --rm busybox:1.38.0 nc -z -w 2 <host-addr> 4222
# create database keycloak on PostgreSQL if absent: container exec -i semiont-postgres psql -U postgres (SQL on stdin)
# write <config-stage>/keycloak-semiont-realm.json (launcher-owned; realm "semiont", clients: semiont-browser, semiont-cli, semiont-archivist, semiont-dispatcher, semiont-gateway, semiont-librarian, semiont-smelter, semiont-weaver, semiont-worker)
container run -d --name semiont-keycloak --memory 1G -p 8080:8080 -v <config-stage>/keycloak-semiont-realm.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/semiont.json:ro -e KC_DB_URL=jdbc:postgresql://<host-addr>:5432/keycloak --env KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD -e KC_DB=postgres -e KC_DB_USERNAME=postgres -e KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME=admin -e KC_DB_PASSWORD quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.7.4 start-dev --import-realm
# wait: http://localhost:8080/realms/semiont (90s)
# open Keycloak's admin to this machine over HTTP: container exec --env KC_CLI_PASSWORD semiont-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh update realms/master -s sslRequired=NONE --no-config --server http://localhost:8080 --realm master --user admin
# client-credentials grant at http://localhost:8080/realms/semiont as semiont-archivist — require flat `roles` containing "semiont-service" and `aud` containing https://example.github.io/test-kb
# client-credentials grant at http://localhost:8080/realms/semiont as semiont-dispatcher — require flat `roles` containing "semiont-service" and `aud` containing https://example.github.io/test-kb
# client-credentials grant at http://localhost:8080/realms/semiont as semiont-gateway — require flat `roles` containing "semiont-service" and `aud` containing https://example.github.io/test-kb
# client-credentials grant at http://localhost:8080/realms/semiont as semiont-librarian — require flat `roles` containing "semiont-service" and `aud` containing https://example.github.io/test-kb
# client-credentials grant at http://localhost:8080/realms/semiont as semiont-smelter — require flat `roles` containing "semiont-service" and `aud` containing https://example.github.io/test-kb
# client-credentials grant at http://localhost:8080/realms/semiont as semiont-weaver — require flat `roles` containing "semiont-service" and `aud` containing https://example.github.io/test-kb
# client-credentials grant at http://localhost:8080/realms/semiont as semiont-worker — require flat `roles` containing "semiont-service" and `aud` containing https://example.github.io/test-kb
# device authorization at http://localhost:8080/realms/semiont as semiont-cli — require the grant to be enabled for it
# authorization request at http://localhost:8080/realms/semiont as semiont-browser — require a redirect to http://localhost:3000/en/auth/callback
# the same request carrying NO code challenge — require it to be refused, so PKCE is enforced rather than merely offered
# password grant at http://localhost:8080/realms/semiont as semiont-browser and semiont-cli, sending no credential — require both to refuse it
# compare `exp - iat` on those tokens against the configured 300s — warn if the realm was imported with another
# mount state state (shared; the stamp stays with its owning service)
container run -d --name semiont-gateway --publish 4000:4000 --memory 2G --volume <config-stage>/gateway.json:/etc/semiont/gateway.json:ro -v <data-home>/roots/example.github.io-test-kb/state:/semiont-state --env OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://<host-addr>:4318 --env SEMIONT_OIDC_CLIENT_ID=semiont-gateway --env SEMIONT_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET --env JWT_SECRET --env SEMIONT_SUPERVISE=1 ghcr.io/the-ai-alliance/semiont-gateway:local
# wait: http://localhost:4000/api/health (120s)
# probe: container run --rm busybox:1.38.0 sh -c "wget -q -O- http://<host-addr>:4000/api/health" (up to 20 tries)
# graph state: <data-home>/roots/example.github.io-test-kb/neo4j (created if absent; reused across restarts)
container run -d --name semiont-neo4j --memory 2G -p 7474:7474 -p 7687:7687 -v <data-home>/roots/example.github.io-test-kb/neo4j/data:/data -v <data-home>/roots/example.github.io-test-kb/neo4j/logs:/logs -e NEO4J_ACCEPT_LICENSE_AGREEMENT=yes -e NEO4J_AUTH neo4j:5.26.28-community
# wait: http://localhost:7474 (30s)

container run -d --name semiont-qdrant --memory 2G -p 6333:6333 -v <data-home>/roots/example.github.io-test-kb/qdrant:/qdrant/storage qdrant/qdrant:v1.19.1
